identity.title: CoralVQA: A Large-Scale Visual Question Answering Dataset for Coral Reef Image Understanding

problem.claim: Enable more accessible analysis and conservation monitoring of coral reef images through visual question answering.

gap.claim: Existing VQA applications lack a dedicated coral-imagery dataset covering domain-specific annotations and multidimensional questions.

contributions.claim: Introduces CoralVQA, described as the first large-scale VQA dataset for coral reef analysis, with real-world images and ecological and health-related question-answer pairs.
Develops a semi-automatic construction pipeline with marine-biologist collaboration, targeting scalability and professional-grade data quality.
Provides a benchmark for vision-language reasoning on coral reef images and identifies challenges for LVLMs.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors characterize CoralVQA as the first large-scale VQA dataset for coral reef analysis.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that CoralVQA contains 12,805 images spanning 67 coral genera and 3 oceans, paired with 277,653 questions and answers.
The authors report evaluations of several state-of-the-art LVLMs that reveal key limitations and opportunities in coral-imagery reasoning.

narrative_sequence.summary: Coral reefs need continuous monitoring, but image interpretation requires specialized expertise.
LVLM-powered VQA could make image interaction more user-friendly, yet dedicated coral-specific data are needed for specialized annotations and multidimensional questions.
The work introduces CoralVQA and builds it through a semi-automatic pipeline involving marine biologists.
The dataset establishes a coral-reef vision-language reasoning benchmark; LVLM evaluations expose limitations and opportunities relevant to future conservation-oriented development.

source_observation.claim: The abstract links dataset design directly to two application-specific challenges—domain-specific annotations and multidimensional questions—and then reports benchmark evaluation of LVLMs.

lessons.interpretation: A compelling resource paper can align the data schema, benchmark purpose, and reported findings around explicit domain constraints.
lessons.application: When introducing a specialized dataset, define the target domain challenges first, encode each in the annotations or task dimensions, and evaluate models against those dimensions.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when the dataset is exploratory and its task dimensions or domain requirements are not yet stable.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the question categories, annotation protocol, data splits, evaluation metrics, or the concrete LVLM limitations and opportunities reported.
The claimed first-of-its-kind status and data quality are author statements; independent verification is unavailable here.
